in_sanskrit.name: Eshanansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Universe
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Eshanansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Eshana: Lord of the Universe, Ansh: Presence, or Breath. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is associated with the Hindu religion.

in_hindi.name: Eshanansh
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Universe
in_hindi.long_meaning: Eshanansh एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Eshana: Lord of the Universe, Ansh: Presence, or Breath. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is associated with the Hindu religion.

in_tamil.name: Eshanansh
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lord of the Universe
in_tamil.long_meaning: Eshanansh ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Eshana: Lord of the Universe, Ansh: Presence, or Breath. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is associated with the Hindu religion.

in_telugu.name: Eshanansh
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Lord of the Universe
in_telugu.long_meaning: Eshanansh ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Eshana: Lord of the Universe, Ansh: Presence, or Breath. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is associated with the Hindu religion.

in_marathi.name: Eshanansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eshanansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eshana: Lord of the Universe, Ansh: Presence, or Breath. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is associated with the Hindu religion.

in_bengali.name: Eshanansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Eshanansh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Eshana: Lord of the Universe, Ansh: Presence, or Breath. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is associated with the Hindu religion.
